meta.title: Nomad in Thailand Community - The Best Place for Nomads
meta.desc: A digital nomad community mainly for 20s. Completely free. Find lifelong friends through sauna, co-working, and casual meetups.

hero.title:
The Era of Struggling Alone
Is Over.
hero.subtitle:
Connect through casual events.
Community of same-generation friends.
Nomad in Thailand accelerates your life in Thailand.

intro.title: Do you have these 'uneasy' feelings?
intro.p1: You came to Thailand for freedom, but found yourself just facing your PC every day...

problems.item2: No friends nearby to invite for dinner or sauna
problems.item3: Wanting real, local info not found on Google
problems.item4: Simply wanting to speak Japanese sometimes

intro.solution:
Solve these worries instantly with
Nomad in Thailand events.

info.title: Attractive Events
info.desc:
Sauna, co-working sessions, drinking parties.
Receive notifications for casual events held irregularly.

friends.title: Same Generation
friends.desc:
Mainly digital nomads in their 20s (30s also present).
With similar values, you can talk like old friends instantly.

business.title: Accelerate Your Business
business.desc:
Engineers, marketers, founders, investors.
New projects often spark from this diverse gathering of talent.

activities.title: Casual Meetups
activities.desc: Events are announced in the OpenChat. No fixed schedule, just gathering when we feel like it. That's the charm.

sauna.title: Sauna & Ice Bath Gatherings
sauna.desc: Not just getting "Totono". The chat with fresh smoothie after the sauna is the best part.

muaythai.title: Muay Thai & Workout Sessions
muaythai.desc: Lack of exercise is a nomad's enemy. Let's sweat together in beginner-friendly gym sessions.

coworking.title: Co-working Sessions
coworking.desc: Afternoons can be lazy alone, but productive together. Just gathering at cafes or co-working spaces to work.

party.title: Behind-the-Scenes Drinks
party.desc: From business talks to dating stories. Lots of talks you can't hear or say in public.

members.title: Who is in the community?
members.desc: Mainly active nomads in their 20s. 30s members are also active.

safety.title: Safety & Quality
safety.desc:
Everyone is welcome, but not "anyone".
We strive to maintain a high-quality community.

features.desc2: Solicitation or spam results in an immediate ban.

atmosphere.title: Laid-back Vibe
atmosphere.desc: No pressure. Main posts are admin-only to keep it clean. Conversations happen in threads.

cta.title: Your Place is Here.
cta.desc:
It's free to join. Free to leave.
If you're hesitant, just take a peek.
cta.note: *Approval required. Please answer "Pakchee" (Cilantro) to the question (password)! 🌱

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Is it really free? Is there a catch?
faq.a1: It is completely free. It's run by volunteers who wanted to create "the place I wished existed when I came to Thailand". No suspicious sales.
faq.q2: Can I join if I'm in my late 30s or 40s?
faq.a2: Of course! While the majority are in their 20s, age doesn't matter if you have a young spirit and enjoy the nomad lifestyle.
faq.q3: Can I ask questions in the chat?
faq.a3: This community is mainly for event announcements. Please note that we do not provide Q&A support. Enjoy the interaction at our events!
faq.q4: What do you check for approval?
faq.a4: We mainly check if it's a spam account. If you have a normal icon and name, you'll be approved quickly.
